requirements.text: Material C&E risks are reflected in the risk appetite statement through key risk indicators with limits or thresholds, monitored at least quarterly.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the Bank's risk appetite framework; evidenced in the risk appetite statement and its quarterly monitoring, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.article: CER-POL-001 §5.1; EBA/GL/2025/01; ECB C&E Guide Expectation 7
requirements.text: A C&E materiality assessment is performed at least annually and whenever a material change in business model or external environment occurs.
requirements.level_reason: Institution-wide risk identification process; evidenced in the Bank's C&E materiality assessment report, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: The materiality assessment covers transition and physical risk drivers and their impact on credit, market, operational, liquidity, reputational and business model risk.
requirements.level_reason: Content requirement for the institution-wide C&E materiality assessment; evidenced in the materiality assessment report, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: The materiality assessment considers short-term (up to three years), medium-term (three to ten years) and long-term (at least ten years) horizons.
requirements.level_reason: Content requirement for the institution-wide C&E materiality assessment; evidenced in the materiality assessment report, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1). Long-term horizon of at least ten years consistent with EBA/GL/2025/01.

requirements.text: The materiality assessment combines exposure-based, portfolio-based and scenario-based methods, with methods, thresholds and data limitations documented.
requirements.level_reason: Methodological requirement for the institution-wide C&E materiality assessment; evidenced in the materiality assessment report, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Any conclusion that a C&E risk is not material is justified and documented with the evidence and thresholds applied.
requirements.level_reason: Documentation requirement for the institution-wide C&E materiality assessment; evidenced in the materiality assessment report, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: The approved materiality assessment outcome feeds the ICAAP risk inventory, the stress testing programme and the model development plan.
requirements.level_reason: Institution-wide process linking the materiality assessment to the ICAAP and planning; evidenced in the ICAAP risk inventory and model development plan, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Real estate collateral valuation takes into account the energy label and the physical risk exposure of the property.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models covering real estate secured exposures only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Each credit risk model documents whether material C&E risk drivers are captured by its risk drivers and calibration data, repeated at each model review.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to credit risk models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Where a material C&E driver is not captured, the model owner proposes inclusion of the driver, a documented adjustment or, for IFRS 9 models, an overlay under FIN-STD-200 §10.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to credit risk models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Internal capital for material C&E risks is quantified in the economic perspective within risk-category models or through a documented add-on methodology.
requirements.level_reason: ICAAP obligation of the institution; evidenced in the ICAAP documentation of the economic perspective, not in the documentation of an individual model.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models used in the ICAAP only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: The ICAAP normative adverse scenario includes C&E risk drivers where they are material over the ICAAP horizon.
requirements.level_reason: ICAAP obligation of the institution; evidenced in the ICAAP scenario documentation approved by the Management Board, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models used in the ICAAP only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.article: CER-POL-001 §8.1; EBA/GL/2025/04; ECB C&E Guide Expectation 11
requirements.text: Climate stress testing and scenario analysis are performed at least annually in accordance with ERM-STD-300 §10 and EBA/GL/2025/04.
requirements.level_reason: Frequency requirement for the Bank's stress testing programme; evidenced in the stress testing programme and its results, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Climate scenario analysis includes at least orderly transition, disorderly transition and hot-house-world scenarios covering both transition and physical risk.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Scenario analysis identifies transmission channels to the portfolios, including energy-label-driven collateral and affordability effects, carbon-price-driven PD changes and physical collateral damage.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Registered energy labels from the national register are used for real estate collateral; estimated labels are flagged and their estimation method documented and validated.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models covering real estate secured exposures only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Energy label coverage and quality, including the share of registered versus estimated labels per portfolio, are monitored quarterly.
requirements.level_reason: Portfolio-level data monitoring obligation of the Bank; evidenced in quarterly C&E data quality reporting, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models covering real estate secured exposures only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Financed emissions are estimated with a recognised financed-emissions methodology covering Scope 1 and 2 and material Scope 3, each estimate carrying a data quality score.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models covering corporate or SME counterparties only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Physical risk is assessed using address-level or asset-level geolocation data for flood, subsidence, drought and extreme weather hazards.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Proxies for missing C&E data are documented, the share of proxied data is reported, and the resulting uncertainty is reflected in risk measurement.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: C&E data used in models comply with MRM-STD-022 and DATA-POL-001, including lineage and data quality controls.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Counterparty C&E data (emissions, transition plans, physical asset locations) are collected at origination and updated at least at each annual credit review.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the credit origination and annual review process; evidenced in credit files and process controls, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models covering corporate or SME counterparties only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: A prudential transition plan with quantified targets and intermediate milestones for the financial risks from the transition is maintained, consistent with the Bank's sustainability disclosures.
requirements.level_reason: Strategic obligation of the institution; evidenced in the prudential transition plan approved by the Management Board, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1). Transition plan requirement introduced by Directive (EU) 2024/1619; confirm article reference (Art. 76(2) / Art. 87a) against the consolidated CRD.

requirements.text: Forward-looking metrics such as sectoral alignment and the mortgage energy label distribution are monitored at least annually against transition plan milestones.
requirements.level_reason: Institution-wide monitoring of the transition plan; evidenced in transition plan progress reporting, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: C&E model documentation describes methodological uncertainty (long horizons, absence of loss history, scenario dependence) and the sensitivity of results to key assumptions.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).

requirements.text: Expert judgement in C&E models, such as the translation of scenario variables into PD and LGD shocks, is documented and approved under MRM-STD-023.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (CER-POL-001 v2.1).
